acceptanceRules: the final diff must match the exact path and change-class allowlist
all blocking checks must pass on the exact final head
red, pending, skipped, or missing required evidence blocks closure
requirement-specific negative, concurrency, failure, and recovery evidence is required where applicable
visual work requires an owner-approved item-level reference and independent verification
agent narrative and historical reports do not substitute for direct evidence
residual gaps, temporary artifacts, data state, and provider state must be reconciled before closure
recoveryRules: code rollback, feature disable, schema compatibility, data compensation, and provider reconciliation are separate decisions
rollback is prohibited when it would discard valid data or reintroduce a security defect without separate approval
every package defines stop triggers and a preserved-evidence safe state
parallelismRules: shared files, schemas, contracts, fixtures, visual surfaces, providers, and environments require one designated owner
a mutable-boundary conflict creates an ordering dependency
agents may not expand scope or edit adjacent boundaries without an amended package version

authorizationMeaning.EVIDENCE_READY: package definition is complete but execution has not started
authorizationMeaning.OWNER_DECISION_PENDING: safe default remains in force and execution is blocked
authorizationMeaning.AUTHORIZED_NON_PRODUCTION: only the named non-production scope is authorized; all sub-authorizations remain false
authorizationMeaning.DEFERRED: represented by DRAFT or BLOCKED with an explicit trigger and residual risk

rules: blank or omitted authorization fields mean not authorized
authorization is single-use, package-specific, version-specific, and time-bounded
general build authority never implies main, migration, data, provider, secret, purchase, external action, or Production authority
completion of Z8 authorizes no package to start automatically
the owner instruction after Z8 determines which EVIDENCE_READY package is activated next
